title: Guido Gozzano
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: The monograph provides the first philologically reliable and annotated edition of 26 prose texts by Guido Gozzano, the leader of Italian Crepuscolarism and among the most influential authors on the literature of the 20th and 21st centuries. In addition to original perspectives on current events of the time, from new techniques of image reproduction to war, the texts provide valuable glimpses into the author's poetic workshop.
